question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Commerce
solution: The correct answer is '**Trade'.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • The word** "Commerce**" refers to the activities involved in buying and selling things, especially on a large scale **(व्यापार)**. • Example: International **commerce** has grown rapidly thanks to advances in technology. • The most appropriate synonym for **"Commerce"** is **''Trade'' ** • **"Trade**" also refers to the action of buying and selling goods and services **(धंधा)**. • Example: The country has a prosperous** trade** in high-quality textiles. Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Stream:** A small, narrow river or a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas. **(धारा)** • **Class:** A set or category of things having some property or attribute in common and differentiated from others by kind, type, or quality **(चीज़ों की एक श्रेणी जिसमें कुछ गुण समान होते हैं और प्रकार या गुणवत्ता के आधार पर दूसरों से भिन्न होते हैं।I** • **Bank:** An organization where people and businesses can invest or borrow money, change it to foreign money, etc. **( एक संगठन जहां लोग और व्यवसाय पैसा निवेश कर सकते हैं या उधार ले सकते हैं I)** 40:T9da, The correct answer is '**Magnificientt'.**
